eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Missouri; at 3:54 PM on AUG 26, 2020 Effective until 7:54 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:

LAST SEEN WEARING UNKNOWN.
